summary: Parkevtate Vosianc re-evaluates IREN after a ~12% fall today (-19% YTD) amid debt/higher-rate fears for riskier AI neoclouds. Down ~33% since his 14 Sep ranking at ~$45, when he said it was not a buying opportunity, he now upgrades it to BUY (dated 14 Oct, low conviction): cash ~$7.6bn vs debt ~$7.8bn, contract prices +~125% since Nov 2025 and prepayments funding much of GPU capex support the case, and his updated DCF is $46 vs $30.56 market (~50% undervalued, even with a 10-20% margin of safety) — despite forecasting deeply negative FCF through FY29. First tracked Parkevtate IREN call.

calls.thesis: Upgrade to BUY (stated in video, dated 14 Oct 2026), low conviction: down ~33% since his 14 Sep 'not a buying opportunity' ranking at ~$45; even with a 10-20% margin of safety (up from usual 5-10%) and sharply lower FCF estimates, DCF $46 vs $30.56 looks ~50% undervalued. First tracked Parkevtate IREN call in calls.json — upgrade is vs his own prior ranking stated in the video, not a tracked flip.
calls.base_case: Cash/short-term investments ~$7.6bn vs long-term debt ~$7.8bn — one of the better neocloud balance sheets; 3-yr contract prices +~125% since Nov 2025; $6.5bn GPU financing secured, customer prepayments funding 45-55% of GPU capex.
calls.bull_case: Supply-short AI compute demand keeps pricing rising; FCF turns positive in 2030 (~$3.5bn est.) then grows rapidly.
calls.bear_case: Huge negative FCF ahead — est. -$21bn FY27, -$18bn FY28, -$17bn FY29 on raised capex; WACC 16.2% (after-tax cost of debt 12.5%); low conviction stated.
